001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.query.filters;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.query.Filter;
005import org.bukkit.Material;
006import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
007
008public final class MaterialFilter implements Filter<Material> {
009
010  @Override
011  public boolean applies(@NotNull final Shop shop, @NotNull final Material material) {
012
013    return shop.getItem().getType() == material;
014  }
015}
